main_body: Small chest-like box: orange banded upper section (rows 1-7), a gold strip (rows 9-10) and a dark lower section with yellow zigzag (rows 11-14).
top_band: Rows 1-3 form a gradient from #b85a1c to #f09a40. A dark line at row 4 follows, then rows 5-7 are lighter again (#ffc26a/#f09a40). No distinct lighter top surface sits above a separate front face.
evidence: The column reads as stacked horizontal bands with the same orange family throughout (L 111-202). Row 4 is a darker line, not a lighter front-edge line, and rows 5-7 are lighter than the supposed top, so the order top-lightest then front is reversed. Rows 1-3 are a shading gradient, not a surface. The rows below are vertical-face bands (gold strip, dark zigzag panel). The result looks like a front-elevation strapped chest with side rivets, not a 3/4 box whose lid is seen from above.

style.evidence: The outline is a tinted dark brown (0% neutral dark edge pixels). The orange ramp has about 4-5 steps plus the gold and blue-grey rivets. There are no flat 5x5 fills (0%). It has 12 colours per tile against 17-20 for the references, which is lower but acceptable for a single-tile piece. Texture is limited to striped bands and rivets, so it is a little plainer than the references but not sticker-like.
